Name: JP's Challenge Modes - Stardew Challenge
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][b][color=#00ff00][size=6][font=Georgia][i][u]Challenge Modes[/u][/i][/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]


[b][font=Georgia][color=#ff00ff][size=5][i]You won't last 5 minutes playing this game... Wait a minute...[/i][/size][/color][/font][/b]


[size=4][font=Georgia]This mod introduces some interesting challenges to add a new kind of replayability to the game. You can go all out and enable them all, or try them out one by one to see what works best for you.[/font][/size]

[size=4][b][font=Georgia][color=#00ffff]The challenges are as follows:[/color][/font][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Without leaving the farm: You cannot leave the farm under any circumstances.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Lock the Farmhouse: You cannot re-enter your house.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Totems: Allows limited use of totems.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Mines: You can go to the mines ONLY by using totems.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Fishing Rod: You can start a new game with this tool in your inventory.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Backpack: Maximum inventory capacity.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Tools: Maximum tool capacity.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Permadeath: If you die, your game will be deleted.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Softdeath: If you die, you’ll be returned to the start of the day.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]No energy: Fainting counts as death.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]No Seeds: No seeds anywhere.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]No Shipping Bin: There isn't one; it doesn't exist.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Limited Resources: You can't buy resources from Clint or Robin.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Limited Storage: Limits the number of chests or storage spaces.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Energy Drain: You constantly lose energy.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]No Buffs: You won't receive buffs from food.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Time Multiplier: Days pass more quickly.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][i]Explosive Mines: Clicking on mines may reveal an active bomb of any of the three types.[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[/list]

[font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]For now, these are the challenges. Remember to use GMCM to easily set them up. [/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]


[b][font=Georgia][i][color=#ff0000][size=5][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; you don't need to ask my permission.
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods. [color=#00ffff](Recommended)[/color]
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size]
